|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 2). The images here, the Players Committee card image and the release-sheet slip, print it. The current text is [[Kuat Drive Yards (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]] (PC-E1).
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 4 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 31E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Unique (•) ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to ▼ a battleground system. We're In Attack Position Now is canceled. [Immune to Alter]” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-31E-Kuat_Drive_Yards.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-kuatdriveyards-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 28) prints this text again, identical character for character<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>. An exact reprint of an earlier text is a stale reprint: it is not a new version and does not make this text current again (wiki versions ruling, 9 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kuat Drive Yards (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, on the Virtual Block 4 list and the Virtual master list in every archived capture from 21 July 2012 (the earliest with game text) to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1240_33">Players Committee website card list: VBlock4Type (Virtual Block 4 list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive); the archived captures from March 2013 on carry no game text</ref>: “Deploy on table. Unique (•) ''Imperial''-Class Star Destroyers draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to ▼ a battleground system. We're In Attack Position Now is canceled. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' “Imperial-class” is written “Imperial-Class”, with a capital C. The text list writes icons out in words and cannot show italics, bold or curly quotes; differences that come only from that are not changes. The list also adds “(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”, a credit line, not card text.
